lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆Hello, Commander★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Sending good vibes to everyone in the Ark, it's me!☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Lovely Dream★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: How have you been?☆
How's your writing coming along?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It's coming along quite nicely★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: No hellos or anything★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I like that in a person★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ★You're perfect★ for the lead role!☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: That's precisely why I contacted you★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: That footage you sent us last time was sublime.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: We were able to cut it together into a thrilling combat scene.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: However, this next ★scene☆ has me in a bit of a slump★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It's the last ★☆major story★☆ beat left, but I've at a loss as to what to write★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: If I want this drama to be a hit,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: the ending must be perfect, and I can't write a single word!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: If anyone from our legions of fans catches wind of this, they'll be devastated.
I don't think that many people are worried.
I'm a fan, and I'm devastated.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Oh my★ such a spitfire you are! Such brutal honesty!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: That's why you'd be ★perfect in the lead role★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Contrary to how things may appear, I assure you that there are many people eagerly awaiting my latest creation.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: You don't say! So you're a fan of my work as well, are you?★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: With that being said, I was hoping you could help me carry this latest show over the finish line★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: If you could send me any new footage that you've shot, I feel it might give me a burst of inspiration★
What kind of footage are you looking for?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Piqued your interest, have I?★ Well, allow me to set the scene:

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: After being attacked by the Raptures, the commander falls unconscious, on the verge of death!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: The Nikkes watch their Commander fall, tears streaming down their faces... ★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It... was an honor to be your Commander.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: No Commander, the honor was all mine.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: And then... a tearful farewell kiss! ★
A kiss? That came out of nowhere.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Hardly!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: A love story isn't complete without a kiss to seal the deal★
If you say so.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I'm glad★ you see things my way☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: This is the climax that I've been building up to all this time☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: So please, try and capture some interesting footage for me, Commander☆★☆★☆★☆★☆
